about.label: CME Group
about.summary: CME Group Inc., headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, operates exchanges and provides clearing services for trading in financial derivatives such as futures contracts, options, and swaps. The company operates the Globex Trading System, an electronic trading platform that allows customers in approximately 150 countries to trade futures and options contracts.

about.label: Coinbase
about.summary: American cryptocurrency exchange. It was founded in 2012 by Brian Armstrong and Fred Ehrsam. The company operates in more than 100 countries and holds nearly US$516 billion in assets, including nearly 12 percent of all bitcoin in existence and 11 percent of all staked Ether.
